Does Brad Pitt die in The Devil's Own?

He plays Frankie McGuire / Rory Devaney.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

Yes. Shot in a final boat standoff with the cop who took him in.

IRA gunman Frankie McGuire hides as 'Rory Devaney' with NYPD sergeant Tom O'Meara's family while buying Stinger missiles. Once exposed, he boards a boat to sail the weapons home. Tom follows; in the shootout Tom is wounded and disarmed, and Frankie is about to finish him when he realizes he too has been shot. He dies in Tom's arms as Tom steers the boat back to shore.
